drafts.text:
My worst days don't come after a loss. They come after a payout.
Payout lands, I feel sharp, and sharp is when I buy more evals and size like I'm not allowed to lose.
It doesn't feel like tilt. It feels like I finally figured it out.
This week: paid Saturday, almost all of it back by Friday.
Next payout, the money moves out and I buy nothing for 48 hours.
drafts.source: Jesus's Oct 30 post + @RealizedTrader's reply (the leak starts after a payout and feels like confidence). Mechanism only.
drafts.why: Real week, new angle (confidence, not tilt) and a commitment that creates a follow-up. Check 'paid Saturday' (Oct 25) and keep the last line only if he will do it.
drafts.why_es: Semana real, ángulo nuevo (confianza, no tilt) y un compromiso que crea una secuela. Confirma 'paid Saturday' (25 oct) y deja la última línea solo si lo va a cumplir.

drafts.text:
Someone under my NQ post wrote: "Direction read A+. Execution on entries F."
That's most of my month.
I read the day right and still enter early, too big, before the level proves anything.
Who else grades their read an A and their entries an F?
drafts.source: @AD_770404's reply on the Oct 29 NQ post.
drafts.why: Strongest format on the account with a quote that names his actual leak. No brackets.
drafts.why_es: El formato más fuerte de la cuenta con una cita que nombra su fuga real. Sin corchetes.

drafts.text:
Spent the weekend rewriting my rules. Same thing I did last weekend.
The version of me that sizes up never opens that document.
So this time the rule doesn't live in a doc. It lives in the platform: [lockout / daily limit / max size set before the open].
If I can still click past it, it isn't a rule.
drafts.source: Jesus's Oct 30 'rewriting my execution framework' post + @RealizedTrader ('plan the access, not just the rules') + @drippy_eth's lockout tip.
drafts.why: Answers the audience and the open lockout question. Fill the bracket with a setting he actually turned on, or do not post it.
drafts.why_es: Responde a la audiencia y a la pregunta abierta del lockout. Llena el corchete con un ajuste que de verdad activó, o no lo publiques.

plan: 11 new posts in 5 days, 4x the volume, flat reach (median 662 views). Followers 887 -> 864, but the chart shows only -1 net from follows and unfollows over Oct 21-31 against -41 in the follower count: about 40 accounts were removed by X, not lost by choice. 83% of remaining followers were active in the last 24h and engagement rate is up. The real issue is growth: new follows fell from 10-35 a day (Vest spike) to 0-4. Plan: max 2 posts a day, one real detail each, drop the engagement-bait questions and the motivational template voice. Draft 1 Mon, Draft 2 Tue, Draft 3 Wed once the platform setting exists.
plan_es: 11 posts nuevos en 5 días, 4x el volumen, alcance plano (mediana 662 vistas). Seguidores 887 -> 864, pero el gráfico muestra solo -1 neto de follows y unfollows del 21 al 31 oct contra -41 en el conteo de seguidores: unas 40 cuentas las eliminó X, no las perdiste por decisión de nadie. El 83% de los seguidores que quedan estuvo activo en las últimas 24h y el engagement sube. El problema real es el crecimiento: los follows nuevos bajaron de 10-35 al día (pico del Vest) a 0-4. Plan: máximo 2 posts al día, un detalle real en cada uno, dejar las preguntas anzuelo y la voz de plantilla motivacional. Draft 1 lunes, Draft 2 martes, Draft 3 miércoles cuando exista el ajuste de la plataforma.
escalate: If posting less lifts the median above 900, keep the cap permanently. If Draft 1 works, the 'leak starts after a payout' idea becomes a recurring series with the payout date and the days until it was gone.
escalate_es: Si publicar menos sube la mediana por encima de 900, mantén el tope de forma permanente. Si el Draft 1 funciona, la idea de 'la fuga empieza tras un payout' se vuelve una serie recurrente con la fecha del payout y los días hasta que se fue.

read.working: A shared-pain question (NQ, 1.6K, 15 replies) and the MFP hook (1.8K) were the best of the window. A real anchor gets replies (Oct 30 confession, 10). Active followers 719 of 864 (83%), 7D engagement rate 3.4% (+73%).
read.working_es: Una pregunta de dolor compartido (NQ, 1.6K, 15 respuestas) y el gancho de MFP (1.8K) fueron lo mejor de la ventana. Un ancla real consigue respuestas (confesión del 30 oct, 10). Seguidores activos 719 de 864 (83%), engagement rate 7D 3.4% (+73%).
read.stop: Posting 11 times in 5 days did not add reach. Generic engagement bait ('How are you handling the charts today?', 'tests your character') sat at 350 to 645. The reply voice ('Let's crush the rest of the week!', 'top tier risk management') reads like a template and gave a troll an opening.
read.stop_es: Publicar 11 veces en 5 días no sumó alcance. El anzuelo genérico ('How are you handling the charts today?', 'tests your character') quedó entre 350 y 645. La voz de las respuestas ('Let's crush the rest of the week!', 'top tier risk management') suena a plantilla y le dio pie a un troll.
read.watch: New follows dried up from 10-35 a day to 0-4. The follower total will keep dropping while X removes dead accounts, so judge by active followers and engagement rate. @RealizedTrader says the leak starts after a payout and 'feels like confidence'. His Oct 30 comment is unanswered.
read.watch_es: Los follows nuevos pasaron de 10-35 al día a 0-4. El total de seguidores seguirá bajando mientras X elimina cuentas muertas, así que juzga por seguidores activos y engagement rate. @RealizedTrader dice que la fuga empieza tras un payout y 'se siente como confianza'. Su comentario del 30 oct sigue sin respuesta.
